command_result.command: cd /app/docs; find . -type f; for f in $(find . -type f -name '*.md' | sort); do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; ls /app/data | sed -e 's/-.*//' | sort | uniq -c; ls /app/tools; ls /app/data | tail -40
cd /app/docs; grep -n 'lb =' summary-format.md; md5sum summary-format.md; cat exports.md | head -60; cat layouts/*

cd /app/data; for f in central-w1.xml central-w6r.xml east-w1.csv harbor-w1.psv lakeside-w1.csv north-w1.jsonl river-w3.tsv south-w1.txt west-w1.csv; do echo "=== $f"; head -c 1500 $f | head -25; done

cd /app/data; grep -n -a -B2 -A3 'overflow' east-*.csv | head -50; grep -a -n -E '^# (batch|charset|dates|unit)' east-*.csv | grep -v 'YMD\|unit: kg' ; grep -a -n -B2 -A4 'columns changed' lakeside-*.csv | head -40; grep -a -c . east-w1.csv; tail -3 east-w1.csv

cd /app/data; grep -a -n -E '^(# |id,|shipped,)' east-w13.csv | head; grep -a -h -E '^[^#]*,[^,]*,(lb|kg|g|oz),' east-*.csv | head -5; grep -a -c -E ',(lb|kg|oz|g),' east-*.csv | grep -v ':0'; grep -a -h -E '^(id|shipped|type|status|gross|net|note)[a-z,]*,[a-z,]*$' east-*.csv | sort | uniq -c

cat > /tmp/x.py <<'EOF'
import os,collections,re
d='/app/data'
c=collections.Counter()
for f in sorted(os.listdir(d)):
    if not f.startswith('central'):continue
    t=open(os.path.join(d,f),'rb').read().decode()
    for m in re.finditer(r'<(\w+)([^>]*?)/?>',t):
        attrs=re.findall(r'(\w[\w-]*)="',m.group(2))
        c[(m.group(1),tuple(attrs))]+=1
    c[('hdr',re.search(r'<export[^>]*>',t).group(0)[:0]+str(re.findall(r'(\w[\w-]*)="([^"]*)"',re.search(r'<export[^>]*>',t).group(0))[1:]))]+=1
for k,v in sorted(c.items(),key=str):print(v,k)
EOF
python3 /tmp/x.py; cd /app/data; grep -h -o 'unit="[^"]*"' central* | sort | uniq -c; grep -h -o 'type="[^"]*"' central* | sort | uniq -c; grep -h -o '<status>[^<]*' central* | sort | uniq -c; grep -h -a -E '^(VOID|COR)' harbor* | head -4; grep -a -h -E 'kind' north* | grep -v '"new"\|amend' | head -3; grep -h -o '"kind": "[a-z]*"' north* | sort | uniq -c; grep -o -h '"weight[a-z_]*"' north* | sort | uniq -c; grep -a -h '\[' north* | head -3
id; ls -ld /app/bin /app/out /app; touch /app/bin/x && echo ok && rm /app/bin/x; touch /app/STATUS.json && echo ok2

I ran it on /app/data to produce /app/out/summary.json, and check_summary.py reports that every value matches the reference figures."}
EOF
python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('/app/STATUS.json'))['status'])"
